summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Osisko Development Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its annual and special meeting of shareholders held on June 23, 2026. The filing includes the election of directors, reappointment of auditor, approval to change the registered office province from Quebec to Ontario, and a name change to 'Osisko Gold Group Inc.' It also notes the grant of deferred share units. This is a routine corporate governance update with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. Consequently, this filing does not constitute a special situation.
